description:
[Admin] The company's users (owners, recruiters, hiring managers, admins) with the profile_id other tools take: a task assignee, a mention, an interviewer, a recruiter, a hiring team member. filter_text searches name and e-mail. role is the company-wide access level (reader = a hiring manager, read only); for who does what on one position pass position_id: only the people on it, each with position_roles (owning_recruiter, and the hiring team roles recruiter, hiring_manager, interviewer...).

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

filter_text.description: Only users whose name or e-mail contains this text.

include_inactive.description: true: also invited and disabled users (deleted ones never).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

position_id.description: Only the users with a role on this multi-stage position (from list_interviews), each with position_roles.

name: list_users
title: List the company's users
